rationale: P identifies braking behaviour and whether it is unintended, which must be characterised to evaluate T. H-3 supports the declared operating conditions and sudden-stopping event, while FR-7 provides the intended collision-avoidance context. Braking behaviour is itself the subject of evaluation, not merely a control mechanism affecting another phenomenon. P does not incorporate sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: The vehicle's braking behaviour, specifically intended versus unexpected braking, directly addresses SG-3.
The scope matches H-3: straight-ahead urban driving at 50 km/h in good weather, with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead.
Sudden stopping while driving is the hazardous event specified by H-3; its temporal character belongs to the braking phenomenon itself.
The reference to braking intended to avoid obstacle collisions is supported by FR-7 and does not incorporate obstacle-detection mechanisms or response deadlines.
